The author found a real gate defect: G7 looked for the class only in the card's entry-symbol file, which here holds the gym register(...) call (gym-aloha/gym_aloha/__init__.py), not the module that defines AlohaEnv (gym-aloha/gym_aloha/env.py:24); G7 now falls back to the module path (MHS/changes/WAVE-B2.md). The reviewer re-ran the gate and recorded the pass. The author's notes as written at the time of the block follow. (After the registry rebuild the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.) Last gate run (2026-10-29, backend fake, check-report.json report_digest sha256:644c364dd1f6c8f1d3172ee16328a483638e10d9dafac0842edfa96f2e17d3e3), trimmed: G1 pass; G2 pass; G3 pass; G4 pass; G5 pass; G6 warn G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL; G7 fail error G7.NATIVE_NOT_FOUND: class AlohaEnv is not defined in gym-aloha/gym_aloha/__init__.py; G8 warn G8.NO_UNIT x4; G9 skip G9.NOT_RUN; FAIL: G7; exit code 1. The package's eight non-gate unit cases pass (python3 -m unittest discover ... -k AlohaCases). This is a gate defect, not a driver defect: the card's entry_symbols[0].file is gym-aloha/gym_aloha/__init__.py and line 3 is register(, while the class AlohaEnv is at gym-aloha/gym_aloha/env.py:24. Minimal repro: PYTHONPATH=MHS/sdk/src python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; from mhs.driver.upstream import UpstreamTree, class_surface; t=UpstreamTree(Path('robots/abrar2652/imitation-learning-aloha')); print(class_surface(t, 'gym_aloha.env:AlohaEnv', hint_file='gym-aloha/gym_aloha/__init__.py').problems); print(class_surface(t, 'gym_aloha.env:AlohaEnv').file)" prints ['class AlohaEnv is not defined in gym-aloha/gym_aloha/__init__.py'] and gym-aloha/gym_aloha/env.py. In _g7 the card file is passed as hint_file; _find_module returns that hint even though module gym_aloha.env would resolve to env.py, so find_class fails. Without the hint, class_surface finds env.py:24 and reset, step, close and render are all in its names, so the fake surface would pass G7. I did not change native to a non-card spelling, skip G7, or use a callable backend to hide it. The package is complete and checked on the fake backend only: simulated R0 GymnasiumDriver for gym_aloha/AlohaInsertion-v0, 14-element Box(-1, 1) action space, 480 x 640 x 3 top image declared with a 4 x 4 x 3 stand-in in fake.py (named in the fidelity gaps), upstream MuJoCo model as F1, no hardware backend, no hardware run, model-authored and unreviewed. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests.
